role: Layer legal submission and Gaelic elite locally exercised authority without claiming uniform English military occupation
map_policy: No filled modern County Tyrone, County Clare, County Galway, Laois or Offaly polygons solely on titled chiefdom names; permit text/hatching or verified fort Points when independently identified.

episodes.region: Tír Eoghain, Gaelic Ulster, not a mapped modern Tyrone county
episodes.crown_action: May 1542 formal ecclesiastical allegiance / Oct 1542 English Earl of Tyrone peerage
episodes.historical_control_effect: Negotiated nominal royal suzerainty, local Gaelic lord retains coercive and political power
episodes.uncertainty: 1544-49 Conn continued private wars against O'Donnell, Maguire and O'Neill rivals, so do NOT draw English Crown direct Ulster map.

episodes.region: Thomond Gaelic lordship, not identical to all modern County Clare or Limerick
episodes.crown_action: 1 July 1543 English peerage Earl of Thomond and Baron Inchiquin, with nephew successor arrangement
episodes.historical_control_effect: Submission/regrant changes allegiance and land tenure form, but local O'Brien and other chiefs still rule estates
episodes.uncertainty: Do not convert modern County Clare into uniform direct English administration in 1543.

episodes.region: Clanricarde Galway lordship; contemporary border unverified
episodes.crown_action: English Crown creation of Earl of Clanricarde (1543); NLI archival finding aid
episodes.historical_control_effect: Negotiated dynastic elite political relationship, not whole county conquest
episodes.uncertainty: Modern County Galway is not documented 1543 direct English territorial rule; location of all constituent sublordships unverified.

episodes.leader: O'Connor and O'More local chiefdoms, targeted by Crown officials
episodes.region: Leinster midlands, not safely represented by all modern Laois/Offaly
episodes.crown_action: Crown military incursion into the O'Connor and O'More lordships attested by Irish Historical Studies research
episodes.historical_control_effect: Armed intervention and possible military occupation of particular sites, not uniform control of all Gaelic Midlands
episodes.uncertainty: Primary campaign routes, camp locations and exact tenure transitions not accessible from abstract, so keep military campaign event unlocated.

chief_editor_note: Irish title/fealty layer is separate from direct garrison urban core Dublin and rural military intervention; actual Gaelic lordship bounds require dated original title maps and enforceability.
